free_tier.stated: no free plan: the Starter 1 GB plan is EUR 3 a month and includes 0.5 TB of public egress under a fair transfer limit
free_tier.notes: A third-party price index lists the same plan as unmetered; the vendor's network-transfer page gives 0.5 TB.

egress.terms: STARTER-1xCPU-1GB includes 0.5 TB of public egress, Fair Transfer Policy applies; public ingress is included with no stated cap; bandwidth is 250 Mbit/s at this size; inbound UDP policy is not stated on the pages read
egress.free_allowance: 0.5 TB a month of public egress on the EUR 3 plan

interface_detail: SSH to the server's public IPv4 or IPv6 address; up to five public IPv4 and five public IPv6 addresses can be attached to one server
tooling: wg-quick or any VPN daemon inside the guest
chaining: a EUR 3 a month origin in London or elsewhere with a public IPv4 and a public IPv6 address; the 0.5 TB included egress, not the price, is the limit

limits.value: 0.5 TB of public egress included on STARTER-1xCPU-1GB, Fair Transfer Policy applies
250 Mbit/s bandwidth on the 1 GB and 1 vCPU size

limits_note: The overage rate beyond the fair transfer limit was not read: the page says transfer 'exceeding the fair amount is no longer automatically charged'.
binding_note: at 1 TiB a month the 0.5 TB included egress runs out first on this size; larger Starter sizes include 1 TB or more

identity_cost.detail: registration asks for name, email address and phone number, and a credit card with a billing address is required to activate the free trial; whether a paid order without the trial needs the same was not read

reliability_note: unverified: no suspension, throttle or data-loss behaviour is stated on the pages read
confidence_note: price, bandwidth and the 0.5 TB allowance are quoted from the vendor's pricing and network-transfer pages read on 2026-11-03; no server was ordered, so inbound UDP was not probed
